title: Clergyman, Westminster Fellowship Meeting - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A July 1957 deckle-edged snapshot showing an indoor meeting where a clergyman in a dark clerical suit and collar stands to address a seated gathering of young adults on wooden folding chairs. The background wall features a prominent Westminster Fellowship seal alongside a Great Seal of the United States emblem, documenting a Presbyterian youth or collegiate fellowship gathering typical of mid-century American religious life.
